{{More citations needed|date=November 2024}}'''{{nihongo|Suwa Yorimitsu|諏訪 頼満}}''' (1480–1540) was a warlord of the {{ill|Shinano Province|en|Shinano Province|qid=Q289250|lt=Shinano Province}}.<ref>{{Cite book |last=川村一彦 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ufgeEAAAQBAJ&dq=%E8%AB%8F%E8%A8%AA+%E9%A0%BC%E6%BA%80&pg=PA57 |title=小田井原の戦い |publisher=歴史研究会 |language=ja}}{{Unreliable source?|reason=The author Kazuhiko KAWAMURA (川村一彦) has published many ebooks through copy-paste plagiarism from the Japanese Wikipedia. Please see [[:ja:WP:CFW#川村一彦の著作物]] ( https://w.wiki/AWqv ). |date=November 2024}}</ref>{{Unreliable source?|reason=The author Kazuhiko KAWAMURA (川村一彦) has published many ebooks through copy-paste plagiarism from the Japanese Wikipedia. Please see [[:ja:WP:CFW#川村一彦の著作物]] ( https://w.wiki/AWqv ). |date=November 2024}} The region that was controlled by Yorimitsu was {{ill|Lake Suwa|en|Lake Suwa|qid=Q1206692|lt=Lake Suwa}}.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=正治 |first=笹本 |date=1992-12-25 |title=Vanished Customs |url=https://cir.nii.ac.jp/crid/1390853649019501568 |journal=国立歴史民俗博物館研究報告 = Bulletin of the National Museum of Japanese History |language=ja |volume=45 |pages=195–212 |doi=10.15024/00000585}}</ref> During the year of 1485, Yorimitsu's father was killed by his own retainers for unknown reasons. But Yorimitsu in the end was a very capable leader, greatly strengthening the domain of {{ill|Suwa Province|en|Suwa Province|qid=Q1192248|lt=Suwa}}.
